result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

The change is in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery and noted the exclusion in its Javadoc. The ordering and the zero-count reps are untouched, so reps with no purchase orders still appear with 0.

I ran `mvn -o test -Dtest='*PurchaseOrderCount*'`, which printed no errors. I didn't check that the pattern matched any test class, and I didn't add a test for the cancelled case. I haven't run your Anna/Bob example.
